description: Small end-to-end (audio) benchmark set. Each sample is synthesized to 16kHz mono PCM wav with macOS `say` (see generate_samples.py), streamed through the real /ws_audio pipeline (VAD -> Whisper ASR -> translation), then scored on WER/CER (ASR), chrF (translation), and full-pipeline latency. 'text' is the reference transcript; 'reference_translation' is the reference target.

samples.reference_translation: 会议将于明天上午九点开始。

samples.reference_translation: 我们本季度的收入增长了百分之十五。
